import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class SSP {
        int n, source, sink;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        
        static class Edge {
            int u, flow, cap, cost, origcost;
            Edge(int u, int flow, int cap, int cost, int origcost) {
                this.u = u;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
                this.origcost = origcost;
            }
        }
        
        List<Edge> edges;
        
        SSP(int n, int source, int sink) {
            this.n = n;
            this.source = source;
            this.sink = sink;
            this.adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            this.edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        int addEdge(int a, int b, int cap, int cost) {
            int result = edges.size();
            adj.get(a).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(b, 0, cap, cost, cost));
            adj.get(b).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(a, 0, 0, -cost, -cost));
            return result;
        }
        
        class State {
            int dist, prev, maxf;
            State(int dist, int prev, int maxf) {
                this.dist = dist;
                this.prev = prev;
                this.maxf = maxf;
            }
        }
        
        int[] distArray;
        int[] prevArray;
        int[] maxfArray;
        
        int[] dijkstra() {
            distArray = new int[n];
            prevArray = new int[n];
            maxfArray = new int[n];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                distArray[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
                prevArray[i] = -1;
                maxfArray[i] = 0;
            }
            
            distArray[source] = 0;
            prevArray[source] = -2;
            maxfArray[source] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
            pq.offer(new int[]{0, source});
            
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int[] cur = pq.poll();
                int d = cur[0], v = cur[1];
                
                if (d != distArray[v]) continue;
                
                for (int edid : adj.get(v)) {
                    Edge ed = edges.get(edid);
                    if (ed.flow < ed.cap && distArray[ed.u] > distArray[v] + ed.cost) {
                        distArray[ed.u] = distArray[v] + ed.cost;
                        prevArray[ed.u] = edid;
                        maxfArray[ed.u] = Math.min(maxfArray[v], ed.cap - ed.flow);
                        pq.offer(new int[]{distArray[ed.u], ed.u});
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return new int[]{maxfArray[sink], distArray[sink]};
        }
        
        int[] bellmanFord() {
            int[] dist = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                dist[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
            }
            dist[source] = 0;
            
            for (int rep = 0; rep < n; rep++) {
                boolean changed = false;
                for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
                    int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).u;
                    int u = edges.get(id).u;
                    if (edges.get(id).flow < edges.get(id).cap && dist[v] != Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2 &&
                        dist[u] > dist[v] + edges.get(id).cost) {
                        dist[u] = dist[v] + edges.get(id).cost;
                        changed = true;
                        if (rep >= n - 1) {
                            throw new RuntimeException("Negative cycle detected");
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!changed) break;
            }
            
            for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
                int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).u;
                int u = edges.get(id).u;
                if (dist[v] < Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2 && dist[u] < Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2) {
                    edges.get(id).cost += dist[v] - dist[u];
                }
            }
            
            return dist;
        }
        
        int[] mfmc() {
            int flow = 0, cost = 0;
            
            boolean hasNegative = false;
            for (Edge ed : edges) {
                if (ed.flow > 0 && ed.cost < 0) {
                    hasNegative = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (hasNegative) {
                bellmanFord();
            }
            
            while (true) {
                int[] result = dijkstra();
                int extraflow = result[0];
                if (extraflow == 0) break;
                
                int atcost = result[1];
                
                // Update flow along the path
                int lastid = prevArray[sink];
                for (int id = lastid; id != -2; id = prevArray[edges.get(id ^ 1).u]) {
                    edges.get(id).flow += extraflow;
                    edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= extraflow;
                }
                
                flow += extraflow;
                cost += extraflow * atcost;
            }
            
            return new int[]{flow, cost};
        }
    }
    
    static final int maxn = 2521;
    static int[][] to = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int[] gp = new int[maxn];
    static List<Integer>[] e = new List[maxn];
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        
        final int max_time = 120;
        int[] a = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            e[x].add(y);
            e[y].add(x);
        }
        
        int nd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < max_time; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                to[i][j] = nd++;
            }
        }
        
        int S = nd++;
        int T = nd++;
        
        SSP flow = new SSP(nd, S, T);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            flow.addEdge(S, to[0][a[i]], 1, 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < max_time; i++) {
            flow.addEdge(to[i][1], T, k, c * i);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < max_time - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int neighbor : e[j]) {
                    for (int z = 0; z <= 52; z++) {
                        flow.addEdge(to[i][j], to[i + 1][neighbor], 1, d * (2 * z + 1));
                    }
                }
                flow.addEdge(to[i][j], to[i + 1][j], k, 0);
            }
        }
        
        int[] result = flow.mfmc();
        System.out.println(result[1]);
    }
}
